register.title: Evan Daniel's n154 certificate at 597e660, issue552
register.headline: A smaller packing of 154 squares from Evan Daniel's size-chaining explorer, certified exactly
register.source_checks: The author reports that his two exact rational checkers, verify_cert.py (separating axes) and verify_cert2.py (polygon intersection), accept the certificate and its regularized drawing, with least certified clearances of 1e-20 for pairs and 5e-21 for walls. The side is the 80-digit KKT point S* = 12.92256640193405950324804230143691... scaled by 1 + 1e-20 about the origin corner, with positive multipliers on the load-bearing contacts (least 1.5e-4), a reduced Hessian positive semidefinite modulo 45 exact flat motions and a jammed first-order MILP in every one of 98 corner-corner branches, and 8 rattlers; those are numerical evidence, as the source says, not proofs. No source program ran here.
register.credit: Credit Evan Daniel (https://github.com/evand/square-packing), whose size-chaining quality-diversity basin explorer, the explorer of issues 465 and 489, found the packing in a time-travel test restarted from the register of 5 October; and credit Francisco Couzo with its start, as the author asks: by the issue's comment of 12 October 14:13 UTC the packing descends from Couzo's 5 October packing of 155 squares with one square removed, after 17 productive rounds at n = 154. The chain never saw SQUISH's packing (T-136), and the source measures the result as a different local minimum from it. The search code, the run and the request were done with Claude (Claude Code), which Evan Daniel directed and reviewed.
register.next_rung: Independently review the retained replay, then decide adoption at 154: the certificate is below the case's ceiling, SQUISH's T-136 adopted on 12 October, by 5.04e-04, and below every other report at 154. Measured for the credit by the third route's arrangement_gap and patch_lineage, it matches neither T-136's packing nor Couzo's 154 (T-098's exact optimum) square for square, and 32 of T-136's squares reappear in it within 1e-9 under the best placement patch_lineage finds, so it is another arrangement than T-136's. Blocks of upright squares reappear to the digit from both of Couzo's packings, 43 from the 155 and 45 from the 154 (T-098's exact optima), so that measurement does not tell the two starts apart; the source's round-by-round trace names the 155. Local minimality is the source's numerical evidence. Final exact-head CI remains required.
